description: Owners only (needs sign-in): Read the business's website sources again now, when the owner says the site changed or one was read long ago (each source in `receptionist` has read_at). Changed text replaces the old and the draft is rebuilt; a site that is down keeps what was read before. Websites are also read again by themselves after a week. source_id: one source; omitted: every website source.
name: read_website_again
title: Read a website again
